statement: NIOSH identifies communication issues and work organization among potential workplace factors affecting cannabis worker mental health and well-being.

review.rationale: Drafted from the reviewed NIOSH cannabis workplace-hazards page and cross-checked against the current NIOSH page on September 15, 2026. This mapping supports the lesson's communication/work-organization context only; it does not establish legal authority, delegation rules, or a specific escalation chain.
review.notes: Human occupational-health review is required before promotion. Keep the claim separate from the lesson's organization-specific authorization rules.

sourceContext.contextTitle: Capability, confidence and authorization are different
